allowed_scope.purpose: Define the minimal governed Python-to-Node subprocess/stdio boundary required to reuse Cline AgentRuntime continuation, tool-call, streaming, and control mechanics while preserving all existing LBE authority owners.
allowed_scope.implementation_changes: architecture/design activation only; no production Python adapter, Node worker, package dependency, sidecar service, RPC service, embedded runtime, or native Cline mutation/execution enablement in this slice
allowed_actions: inspect current LBE authorization, governed tool orchestration, provider-turn, session, event, receipt, persistence, and process owners
reuse the completed Cline Core Reuse Boundary Matrix at audited revision 8bbdde2a5c1f972864fe1b954f639c21fac61a40
define a bounded child-process stdio protocol with Python LBE as lifecycle and authority owner
define request, response, error, event, cancellation, tool proposal, and tool-result message identities
define Cline native mutation/execution tools as disabled or unreachable
define exact mapping from Cline tool call identity to LBE operation_id and ToolReceipt identity
define failure, restart, timeout, protocol-corruption, and child-exit behavior as fail-closed
define package/runtime/dependency adoption evidence required before implementation
update only directly related architecture, acceptance, checkpoint, and machine-gate documentation
run implementation-gate validation and git diff --check
